about: Public data the validation suites use, downloaded and checked by node validation/fetch.mjs into validation/cache/<data set>/. Nothing here is stored in the repository or the MaveScape program. MaveDB's API writes its CSV files the same way each time (checked 2026-10-08); if a checksum stops matching, MaveDB has rewritten the file and the reference outputs that depend on it must be regenerated.

mavedb-grb2-sh3.title: GRB2 SH3 domain, Domainome abundance (urn:mavedb:00000835-a-1)
mavedb-grb2-sh3.description: Two populations (input and output of a yeast abundance selection, aPCA) × 3 biological replicates; 1,121 variants of a 56-residue domain (UniProt P62993, offset 158), WT row p.=. Scored by the authors with DiMSum 1.2.11 (absolute growth rates), rescaled so WT = 0 and the 2.5th percentile of missense variants = −1.

mavedb-brca1-ring.title: BRCA1 RING domain, E2 binding and Y2H (urn:mavedb:00000003-a-1 and -a-2)
mavedb-brca1-ring.description: Time series: E2 binding by phage display, 2 libraries × 3 replicates × 6 rounds (inputs shared within a library), and yeast two-hybrid, 2 libraries × 3 replicates × 4 time points (0/18/37/45 and 0/16/41/64 in the column names, units not stated in the record; non-uniform), in one count table. 909-nt DNA target (BRCA1 codons 2–304); -a-1 at nucleotide level (20,724 variants), -a-2 at amino-acid level (12,316). Scored by the Enrich2 authors with weighted least squares and random-effects combination; Enrich2's legacy _wt and _sy rows.
mavedb-brca1-ring.source: MaveDB; Starita et al., Genetics 2015 (doi:10.1534/genetics.115.175802), rescored in Rubin et al., Genome Biology 2017 (doi:10.1186/s13059-017-1272-5)

mavedb-factor9.title: Coagulation factor IX, MultiSTEP secretion, strep II tag (urn:mavedb:00001200-a-1)
mavedb-factor9.description: FACS bins: 3 tiles × 4 bins × 3 biological replicates; 9,682 variants of the 461-residue protein (WT row p.= in every tile). Scored by the authors as VAMP-seq weighted averages (bin weights 0.25–1), rescaled per replicate so the median of WT barcodes = 1 and the median of the lowest 5% of missense variants = 0, averaged over replicates.
mavedb-factor9.source: MaveDB; Popp et al., Nature Structural & Molecular Biology 2025 (doi:10.1038/s41594-025-01582-w)

dimsum-demo.title: DiMSum's demo variant counts (TDP-43, lehner-lab/DiMSum inst/demo)
dimsum-demo.description: DiMSum's own count table: 40,591 whole nucleotide sequences (lower case; CRLF line ends, the last line unterminated) × 4 input and 4 output samples, and its experiment design file (old Mac line ends, CR only). The wild type, 126 nt (42 codons), is set in DiMSum's R/dimsum.R for --runDemo.
dimsum-demo.source: https://github.com/lehner-lab/DiMSum (Faure et al., Genome Biology 2020, doi:10.1186/s13059-020-02091-3)
